payload.title: Export/import: reviews e iniciativas
payload.description:
## Origen

Hueco post-dry: cycles/saved-views/project-updates ya van en meta/; reviews e initiatives no.

## Criterios

- Exportar `meta/reviews.json` y `meta/initiatives.json` (con project links)
- Importar en rebuild sin pérdidas silenciosas
- Tests de round-trip

payload.body:
Implementado:
- Export meta/initiatives.json y meta/reviews.json
- Import en rebuild (iniciativas tras projects; reviews tras issues)
- Test de round-trip
